name: Kampalo ads assistant
tagline: Briefs synced ad spend and ROAS, then drafts pauses you approve before anything changes
description: Points at a Kampalo workspace where Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 and Search Console are already synced, then reads back what each channel spent and returned. It flags campaigns that are drifting and writes up a suggested pause or an alert, but nothing goes live until you confirm the action yourself.
author: kampalo
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
